incident-bot: Incident detected 2026-03-15T21:12:35Z — runtime nodes flapping, multiple container restarts on gpu-rt-02/gpu-rt-03. Auto-classified: CUDA OOM cascade. Severity: P1 :rotating_light:

maria: noticing slow memory creep in paged-attn allocator. 48h trend shows steady kv slab fragmentation increase, small growth per deploy but now hits at load spikes.

raj: logs from gpu-rt-02 show repeated: `CUDA error: out of memory` then `container restart` then `kv_slab: reclaimed 0 bytes, fragmentation 87%`

maria: exact — fragmentation creeping from ~60% -> 87% over 2 days, GC not reclaiming because hot prefixes keep pinning pages.

devin: I can drain gpu-rt-02 and 03. want me to start?

jess: yes drain both, shift traffic to dedicated pool (gpu-rt-05..07). quick drain + no-serve for new sessions.

alyssa: pinging SRE on-call for live mitigation. also prepping customer impact list.

customer-ops: impacted customers flagged by anomalies: AcmeCorp (high qps), NovaRetail (batch embedding jobs). Holding pattern until warm failover completes.

raj: dropping a snippet of the most recent dmesg + runtime logs:

```
[ 2153.412345] magma_runtime: CUDA error: out of memory (alloc 1.2GB)
[ 2153.412402] runtime: kv_slab_alloc: attempted alloc 1.2GB, free_chunks 0
[ 2153.412410] runtime: paged_attn: page_pin failure, pin_count: 13
[ 2153.412420] runtime: kv_slab: fragmentation check: total=12GB, largest_free=1.5GB, frag=87%
[ 2153.412430] containerd: restarting container job=redwood-runtime id=abcdef
```

maria: reproduction pattern — steady low-level allocations from prefix caching + long chat sessions cause many small pinned pages. Allocation path isn't coalescing because pages are non-adjacent. Over time fragmentation -> effective OOM on spike.

devin: draining now — `redwoodctl node drain gpu-rt-02 --grace-period 30s` and `--force-evict-long-sessions`

jess: while draining, flip temporary mitigation: reduce KV cache retention TTL and disable prefix prefetch for live traffic. set env `KV_PREFETCH=off` and `KV_CACHE_TTL=60s` on the runtime container image.

maria: agree. that should let GC reclaim more. also set `ALLOC_SLAB_RESERVE=1GiB` on affected nodes to avoid hitting tiny free-chunk issues.

raj: rolling config now to gpu-rt-02/gpu-rt-03 via canary.

incident-bot: Action logged: `drain` by devin, `config-toggle` by jess. Ticket INC-20260315-42 created and linked.

alyssa: customer ops has messaged AcmeCorp & NovaRetail with ETA ~20m for failover; gave guidance to pause large batch runs.

customer-ops: AcmeCorp confirmed degraded latency on model route `gpt-xl-cache-1` — they will throttle for 30m. NovaRetail paused nightly job.

raj: after the first restart sequence we saw one node come back stable, second node flapped twice then stabilized once KV TTL was lowered.

maria: running a quick heap map on the runtime process — posting allocation map next.

```
heap-map: gpu-rt-02 pid=4231
kv_slab: total=12GB, used=10.6GB
  slab_bins: [0.5GB: 120, 1MB: 2400, 4KB: 12000]
pinned_pages: 13k
hot_prefixes: 320 (top 10 account for 65% of pins)
```

maria: interesting signal — top prefixes are from a small set of long-running sessions + one customer stream. that matches AcmeCorp.

jess: mitigation checklist for now:
- drain nodes (done)
- reduce KV TTL (done)
- disable prefetch (done)
- increase slab reserve (in progress)
- schedule controlled restart after drain (in progress)

devin: restarting containers on drained nodes now. `systemctl restart redwood-runtime`

raj: one restart returned `cudaErrorMemoryAllocation` for a while, then kernel reclaimed pages after restart; second restart clean. no further OOMs in logs for 6m.

incident-bot: Current status: mitigation applied, traffic shifted, customers notified. Monitoring for recurrence for 30m.

maria: root cause hypothesis: allocator fragmentation due to long-lived pinned KV pages + aggressive prefetching. Paged-attention allocator doesn't coalesce freed pages across different page classes causing slow leak-like effective growth.

jess: next steps (post-incident):
- add periodic compaction path to kv_slab to coalesce small free chunks
- add telemetry for per-prefix pin lifetime and a kill-switch for very long pins
- add alert for fragmentation >75% over 24h window
- revisit prefetch heuristics

alyssa: we'll include customer impact summary in incident report: AcmeCorp (latency spike, short throttling), NovaRetail (batch paused), SSOTeam internal tests affected. No data loss.

customer-ops: AcmeCorp asked for postmortem and mitigation timeline; they're ok with rolling fix if we can promise compaction plan and improved alerts.

maria: leaving handoff notes for next on-call:
- root cause: slow KV fragmentation + pinned pages
- temporary mitigation: TTL + disable prefetch + slab reserve + drains
- monitoring: fragmentation metric, pinned_count, top-prefix map
- followups: design compaction + pin-time alerts + safe-prefetch
devin: handing off to night oncall at 2026-03-16T02:00Z. will leave job links in ticket INC-20260315-42.

jess: add runbook snippet to ticket for restart + drain sequence and env toggles.

incident-bot: Handoff annotated. Incident archived to active until 30m stable watch passes. :white_check_mark:
